text:
elena: Quick help pls. Flew to Lisbon, woke up with bad allergic reaction and had to go to urgent care. Corporate card was declined earlier at a taxi so i used personal card and cash. I paid clinic €220 (itemized invoice), had two prescriptions €35, and missed one conference lunch (they provided boxed lunch). Questions: 1) Can i be reimbursed for the urgent care + meds? 2) Do i file a travel-insurance claim first or submit to finance? 3) How does per-diem work for the hospitalization/clinic day? 4) If the corporate card got declined, who do i notify for replacement and will finance advance me cash retro?

liz (People Ops): Sorry that happened! Short answers: 1) yes medical expenses for an emergency incurred on a business trip are reimbursable. 2) Submit an expense for reimbursement AND open a travel-insurance claim (they may reimburse some items directly). Finance will reconcile amounts. 3) If you were incapacitated and didnt consume company-provided meals we treat the day as medical; you can claim actuals for meals or per-diem minus any provided meals (mark lunch provided). 4) Travel Ops should block and replace corporate card. For urgent personal cash used because card declined, finance can process an expedited reimbursement if manager approves. More details below.

elena: what docs do you need? the clinic gave a small slip in Portuguese.

josh (Finance): Acceptable docs: itemized clinic invoice with provider name/date (scan/photo ok), pharmacy receipts, card statement showing the charge, and a short incident note explaining the emergency. If the receipt is non-English, upload the original + short English summary of line items. For insurance: include the claim number once you file. Dont include sensitive medical notes in the expense file  redact PHI and attach only invoice/diagnosis code if needed.

tara (Benefits): Travel Insurance process: file a claim at https://travel-insurance.vendor/claims using policy ID RW-TRAVEL-2026. Attach invoices and boarding passes. Insurance often covers medical + evac if needed. If insurance pays you back, please notify finance so we can adjust reimbursements. If insurance reimburses the company directly, finance will reconcile and notify you.

elena: how fast can finance reimburse? i paid cash for taxis back to hotel too.

josh (Finance): For expedited reimbursements tag the expense "urgent-medical" and add manager sign-off in the notes. We aim to process expedited medical reimbursements within 3 business days post-approval. Regular processing is 2 payroll cycles. For cash taxi receipts, include a paper receipt or a photo and a short note listing route and amount.

liz (People Ops): Corporate card: DM travel-ops@ with "card block" and last 4 digits. They will cancel and expedite a replacement. If you need a small travel advance now, ask manager and cc finance; we can issue a one-off advance but it requires manager approval and travel-ops coordination.

elena: sample expense note i should paste?

josh (Finance): Paste this into expense notes:
```
Trip: Lisbon conf 2026 - 2026-09-15
Expense: Urgent care clinic - total 220 EUR (itemized invoice attached). Pharmacy - 35 EUR (receipts attached). Taxi cash 12 EUR (receipt photo). Corporate card declined earlier at 2026-09-14 18:32 - travel-ops notified. Insurance claim filed: #CLM12345. Manager approval: Jordan (dm ok). Please expedite - medical reimbursement requested.
```

travel-insurance-bot: Filing link: https://travel-insurance.vendor/claims Policy: RW-TRAVEL-2026. Emergency hotline: +44-20-5555-1212.

elena: thanks everyone, uploading docs now. will follow up once insurance replies. :heart:
